subject: Bridge letter request, audit-period clarification, and contract tie-in for Medisoft renewal
messages:
From: Elaine Chu <elaine.chu@medisoft.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@medisoft.com
Date: 2026-11-19T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II, bridge letter, and renewal evidence (Medisoft renewal)

Hi Tessa,

We're working to close the procurement checklist for our upcoming renewal/expansion with Redwood (Medisoft deal). Procurement has a hard internal deadline of 2026-12-10 to get the security artifacts and contract language confirmed. Can you help us with the following items?

- Latest SOC 2 Type II report (redacted copy is fine for now).
- A bridge letter or attestation that covers the renewal effective date (we need temporary coverage until Redwood's next Type II is issued).
- Clarification of the audit period covered by the current Type II (we need exact dates to align with our GRC requirements).
- Confirmation whether the bridge letter should be referenced in our PO or the MSA (we prefer MSA amendment but want Redwood to confirm).

I've attached the procurement questionnaire for context (Procurement-Questionnaire_Medisoft.xlsx). If a short call would help, we can do 30 minutes this week — procurement is flexible.

Thanks,
Elaine Chu
Sr. Sourcing Manager, Medisoft Health
elaine.chu@medisoft.com
+1 415-555-0198

--

Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II, bridge letter, and renewal evidence (Medisoft renewal)

Hi Elaine — thanks for the clear list and the questionnaire. Looping in Marissa (Head of Compliance) and Neha (Renewals lead) so we can move quickly.

Proposed plan:
1) Marissa will share a redacted SOC 2 Type II PDF and a draft bridge letter for your legal team to review by end of day tomorrow (11/20).
2) For full (unredacted) report access we usually require a signed NDA — if you want that, let me know and I can send the standard compliance NDA; we can also provide access via our secure compliance portal after NDA acceptance.
3) We'll draft suggested contract language to reference the bridge letter in the MSA (preferred) and can also provide PO language if your procurement team prefers.

Quick questions to confirm scope:
- What renewal effective date should the bridge cover? (I saw 2027-01-15 on the procurement timeline; confirm if that's final.)
- Is Procurements' 12/10 deadline for acceptance of the docs or signature on an amendment?

I'll get the initial artifacts over to you tomorrow.

Best,
Tessa Morgan

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T11:23:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II, bridge letter, and renewal evidence (Medisoft renewal)

Hi Elaine — thanks, and apologies for the short lead time. Attaching a redacted copy of our most recent SOC 2 Type II and a draft bridge letter for your legal and procurement teams.

Key points (summary):
- Attached redacted SOC 2 Type II covers the period 2025-09-01 through 2026-08-31 (testing period). The report date is 2026-09-15 (Type II auditor opinion issued).
- We anticipate the next Type II (covering 2026-09-01 through 2027-08-31) will be available Q1 2027; until then we can provide a signed bridge letter that attests to continuity of controls and lists any material changes since the last report.
- Bridge letter limitations: the letter is an attestation of controls continuity and is not a substitute for a full SOC 2 report. For high-sensitivity reviews we provide the full report under NDA and can schedule a Q&A call with our auditor if needed.

Deliverables attached:
- SOC2-TypeII-Redwood-2025-redacted.pdf (redacted executive summary and auditor opinion included)
- redwood-bridge-letter-2026-draft.docx (draft bridge letter; editable so legal can request edits)

Next steps I recommend:
1) Review the redacted report and the draft bridge letter.
2) Confirm whether Medisoft needs the bridge referenced in the MSA (recommended) or the PO. If you send the exact clause or language your legal team wants, we can review and propose final wording.
3) If you want the unredacted report, please sign the attached NDA (I can circulate a DocuSign powerform link).

Happy to hop on a 30-minute call tomorrow morning to go through specifics — Tessa/Neha, can you confirm availability?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Compliance, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

- SOC2-TypeII-Redwood-2025-redacted.pdf (redacted, 1.1 MB)

From: Elaine Chu <elaine.chu@medisoft.com>

Date: 2026-11-21T16:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II, bridge letter, and renewal evidence (Medisoft renewal)

Marissa — thank you, this is exactly what procurement and legal needed for an initial review. A few quick items: 

- The redacted report and draft bridge letter look acceptable to Legal as a near-term artifact. Legal asked that the bridge explicitly state the audit period covered by the existing Type II (we got that) and that the bridge have a firm expiration date — our preference is to tie expiration to the expected issuance of Redwood's next Type II (please insert a date or range).
- Procurement would like the bridge to be referenced in the MSA as an amendment (we will not rely on PO-only language for this renewal). Can you propose a short MSA amendment clause? Example language we like: 
  \"For the duration of the renewal process, Seller shall provide temporary audit coverage as described in the bridge letter dated [date], such bridge letter to be incorporated by reference into this Agreement until the next SOC 2 Type II report is issued.\"
- Our internal signature deadline for the amendment/document acceptance is 2026-12-08. If Redwood can provide the final signed bridge and the proposed MSA amendment language by 12/08, Procurement can route for signatures the same day.
- We will execute an NDA if you send the DocuSign powerform — please send the link and we will complete it today.

If you can confirm the final bridge expiration date (we'd like a concrete calendar date for the amendment rather than "Q1 2027"), that will smooth Legal review. Otherwise, I think we're in good shape.

Thanks again,
Elaine Chu
Sr. Sourcing Manager, Medisoft Health
elaine.chu@medisoft.com
